description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'PathUtils' which provides static helper methods for managing filesystem paths, primarily for configuration files, system directories, and other standard locations used in the software project. It includes methods to retrieve paths for cache, bin, sbin, storage, temporary directories, and system paths, with support for overriding via system properties.

classes.name: PathUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for retrieving and managing filesystem paths, with support for system property overrides and default values.

methods.name: getDynamicConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the path to dynamic configuration files, typically '/opt/etc' or overridden by system property.

methods.name: getStaticConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the path to static configuration files, typically '/vendor/etc' or overridden by system property.

methods.name: getBrandDefaultsPath
methods.description: Returns the path to brand default configurations, based on static config path.

methods.name: getSystemBinPath
methods.description: Returns the system binary directory path, defaulting to '/system/bin'.

methods.name: getSystemEtcPath
methods.description: Returns the system etc directory path, defaulting to '/system/etc'.

methods.name: getTempPath
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory path, defaulting to '/tmp'.

methods.name: getDynamicCachePath
methods.description: Returns the path to dynamic cache files, defaulting to '/cache'.

methods.name: getDynamicBinPath
methods.description: Returns the path to dynamic bin files, defaulting to '/vendor/bin'.

methods.name: getDynamicSBinPath
methods.description: Returns the path to dynamic sbin files, defaulting to '/vendor/sbin'.

methods.name: getDynamicStoragePath
methods.description: Returns the storage directory path, default is '/data' on Android, or overridden by property.

methods.name: getDynamicPath
methods.description: Returns the base dynamic path, defaulting to '/opt'.

methods.name: getStaticPath
methods.description: Returns the static path, defaulting to '/vendor'.

methods.name: getForcedTroubleDirname
methods.description: Returns the path to the 'forcedTrouble' directory, used on Android devices.
